'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of the Svatove-Kreminna line]]
****[[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian forces]] claim that they are closing in on the city of [[Kreminna]] in [[Luhansk Oblast]]. According to governor [[Serhiy Haidai]], [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian fighters]] in some parts of the city were forced to retreat to neighboring [[Rubizhne]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/dec/27/ukraine-says-its-forces-are-close-to-recapturing-key-eastern-city-of-kreminna (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Northern Mindanao floods]]
**The death toll from [[monsoon]] floods in the [[Philippines]] has increased to 32, with 24 others still missing. Eighteen of the deaths occurred in [[Northern Mindanao]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-weather-storms-disaster-planning-and-response-philippines-a86c9907fa2e79d12a95aaab67774668 (AP)]
*[[2022 Omdurman bus crash]]
**Sixteen people are killed when a bus collides with a [[dump truck]] on the outskirts of [[Omdurman]], [[Khartoum (state)|Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/least-16-killed-bus-crash-sudan-2022-12-27/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian oil price cap]]
***[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] issues a [[Decree of the President of Russia|decree]] to prohibit the exports of [[Petroleum industry in Russia|Russian oil and petroleum products]] to countries and organizations that adhere to the [[United States dollar|US$]]60-per-barrel [[price cap]] that [[Australia]], the [[European Union]], and the [[G7]] member states agreed upon earlier this month. The decree will be in effect from February 1 to July 1. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russia-to-ban-oil-exports-to-countries-using-price-cap-from-february-news-agency-afp-3642999 (AFP via NDTV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot]]
**A federal judge in [[Michigan]], [[United States]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] a man to 16 years in prison for plotting to [[kidnap]] [[Michigan governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] in 2020. The man was also [[conviction|convicted]] of [[conspiracy (crime)|conspiring]] to use a [[weapon of mass destruction]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/27/politics/adam-fox-sentenced-whitmer-kidnapping-plot/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Title 42 expulsion]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] rules 5–4 to maintain [[Title 42 of the U.S. Code]], allowing the [[Government of the United States|government]] to remove persons who have recently been in a country where an [[infectious disease]] was present. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20221227-us-supreme-court-keeps-in-effect-health-policy-used-to-block-migrants (AFP via RFI)]
*[[South Korean president]] [[Yoon Suk-yeol]] [[pardon]]s former president [[Lee Myung-bak]] as part of a mass pardon aimed at "national unity". Lee had been serving a 17-year sentence for [[corruption in South Korea|corruption]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/12/27/south-koreas-jailed-ex-president-lee-gets-presidential-pardon (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Government of the Republic of China|Taiwanese government]] announces that it would extend the required duration for [[Conscription in Taiwan|conscription]] from four months to one year, citing the increasing threat of [[China]] using [[People's Liberation Army|military force]] to pursue [[Chinese unification]]. The reform, which will apply to men born after January 1, 2005, will take effect in 2024. [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/taiwan-extends-mandatory-military-service-from-four-months-to-one-year/hqj369xtp (AFP via SBS World News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 NBA season]]
**[[Slovenia]]n [[point guard]] [[Luka Dončić]] of the [[Dallas Mavericks]] scores the first 60-point [[triple-double]] in the [[National Basketball Association]], the premier men's [[professional basketball]] [[Sports league|league]] in the world, after recording 60 [[Point (basketball)|points]], 21 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]], and 10 [[Assist (basketball)|assists]] in the Mavericks' 126–121 [[Overtime (sports)#Basketball|overtime]] win against the [[New York Knicks]] in [[Dallas]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/basketball/64107654 (BBC Sport)]
